translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Bende nitiere ngʼat mapiem gi Jehova Nyasaye Maratego manyalo kwere?
Mad koro ngʼat mamino wach gi Nyasaye oduokeane!”

content: Eka Ayub nodwoko Jehova Nyasaye kama:

content.text: “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ok aromo dwokora kodi
omiyo mano ema omiyo alingʼ.
Asewuoyo moromo, to ok ayudo dwoko
omiyo koro ok abi wuoyo kendo.”

content: Eka Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko Ayub gi ei yamo maduongʼ. Nowacho kama:

content.text: “Chungʼ ane ka dichwo; mondo idwoka weche,
ma adwaro penjigi.
“Angʼo momiyo iketho adiera mara?
Angʼo momiyo iketo rach kuoma mondo in inenri ka ngʼama ber?
Bende in gi teko machalo gi mar Nyasaye
koso dwondi bende nyalo mor kaka mare?
Ka kamano, to kare bidhriane,
kirwakori gi duongʼ, luor kod ber.
Bangʼ mano rang jogo ma sungore,
kendo iol mirimbi mager kuomgi mondo omi gibolre.
Ee, rang joma sungore duto kendo,
ikumgi kama gichungoeno mondo omi gibolre.
Ikgi duto e lowo;
mondo ji kik negi kendo.
Kinyalo timo kamano to an owuon ema anakuong paki
ni tekri iwuon ema omiyo iloyo.
“Parane rawo, mane achweyo kaka ne achweyi
kendo machamo lum kaka rwadh pur chamo.
Parie teko mangʼeny ma en-go,
kendo parie teko maduongʼ manie leche mag dende!
Iwe yamo tero ka yiend sida;
kendo leche manie bembene omoko kuome maber.
Chokene otegno ka mula,
kendo tiendene otegno ka chuma.
Ikwane kaka chwech maberie moloyo mar Nyasaye e kind le duto,
kendo en mana Jachwechne kende ema nyalo chome gi ligangla.
Ochamo lumbe motwi ewi got,
kuonde ma le mager ema kwayoe.
Onindo piny ei saka kendo opondo
e dier odundu motwi e thidhna.
Saka oime gi tipone;
kendo omburi motwi e tie aora olwore.
Kata ka aora opongʼ moo oko, to ok bwoge;
chunye ngʼich angʼicha kata ka aora Jordan opongʼ kendo mwomore marach.
En ngʼa manyalo dino wangʼe mi make,
kata madi duode mi tuch ume?
